description: 电影分镜、故事场景、概念设定、短剧帧
pitfalls: 场景和角色必须分开描述：先写环境再写角色动作
用电影术语控制画面：close-up/medium shot/wide shot/over-the-shoulder
叙事节拍(narrative beat)要明确——画面里正在发生什么事
情绪关键词比场景描述更能决定画面氛围

story_context.narrative_beat: Two figures face each other, a secret about to be revealed

characters.description: Woman in trench coat, wet hair
characters.action: Holding up a glowing USB drive

composition.focus: The glowing USB drive between them

filled.environment: Neon signs reflecting on wet pavement, steam rising from manhole
filled.lighting: Neon blue and pink cross-lighting, rain backlit
